strategy.offer: Industrial heat exchange equipment, cooling and heating systems, and lifecycle services including installation, maintenance, repairs, upgrades, spare parts, and performance-based usage models.
strategy.customers: Industrial customers worldwide in energy, process industries, food, buildings, data centers, marine, refrigeration, heavy industry, and transportation.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects to win through customized integrated solutions, proven reliability in demanding conditions, broad service support, continuous improvement, and focus on customer and stakeholder expectations.
strategy.resources: Its basis is long heat-exchange experience, global manufacturing and service presence, trained engineers and technicians, broad portfolio, testing facilities, and disciplined quality systems.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward more efficient, lower-emission heat exchange, waste-heat recovery, and continuously improved products, services, and operational sustainability.
